requests.description: Returns all details of a single order, including last status, items shipped or not.

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Confirm shipment canceletion (when requested by the customer) or failure to deliver

requests.description: Confirms that a shipment was delivered. Must inform quantity of successfully deliverd items even if items deliverd was less than the original order

requests.description: This enpoint to confirm item exchange when failure to deliver or requested by the customer. All customer requests are tracket via trouble tickets

requests.summary: Confirm order item return and refund

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Update new order to include shipment information

requests.description: Returns a list of shipments shipped. By Default returns items ordered by dateCreated folowed by last update

requests.description: Allows bulk updates of orders shippments.

requests.description: Returns a list of approved orders. Orders in the `approved` state must be fullfiled imediadetelly.
requests.name: Return list of approved orders

requests.description: Returns a list with canceled orders. Canceled orders should not be fullfiled.
requests.name: Returns lists of canceled orders
requests.summary: Returns lists of canceled orders

requests.description: Returns a list of partially deliverd orders. This is a list of orders with items shipped but with not all items ackwlodged as deliverd
requests.name: Returns a list of partially deliverd orders
requests.summary: Returns a list of partially deliverd orders

requests.description: Returns a list of orders that contain one (or more) items that where not shipped. This will list the entire order as well the items with peding shipment. Use this service to track orders that need to be fullfiled.
requests.name: Returns a list of orders partially fullfiled
requests.summary: Returns a list of orders partially fullfiled

requests.description: Returns a list with orders completely fullfiled, this means orders with all items sent. Orders will ordered by dateCreated fowllowed by last update
requests.name: Returns a list with orders fully sent
requests.summary: Returns a list with orders fully sent

requests.description: Use this enpoint to create a single new product to the Marketplace. This enpoint expects a json document with one product. If you whant to upload multiple products in a single API call use POST /products method. The server will load each product as an individual item that can be manipulated using your own `skuSellerId`. This system is idenpontent, this means that once a `skuSellerId` is created it cannot be re-created using this tool. In order to update, edit a product use the PUT method with the correct reference to your `skuSellerId`
requests.name: Create a new product to the marketplace
requests.summary: Create a new product to the marketplace

requests.description: Returns detailed information of a single product with the seller `skuSellerId`. This service will return a json document with product detail, status, price, invetory among other infomarion availble in the Brand Lovers marketplace
requests.name: Returns details of a single product using the seller `skuSellerId`
requests.note: Replace {{BRANDLOVERS_MARKETPLACE_API_V1_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Returns details of a single product using the seller `skuSellerId`

requests.description: Update a single product information such as name, brand, attribute, dimension, etc. Please note that data from your request will be merged with existing data. This allows you to easliy update only certain fields without the need to re-inform the other unchanged fields. For example in order to update just the field `title` simply send just this field with new information, remaining fields will not be changed. In order to erase an item the field must be informed as its default value, for example in order to erase the `videos` field must be sent as videos:[]. The `skuSellerId` field is always mandatory in the path and in the product json Object.
requests.name: Update product details
requests.note: Replace {{BRANDLOVERS_MARKETPLACE_API_V1_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Update product details

requests.description: Allows seller to set the SKU prices (MSRP and/or offer price). All prices must be informed in cents. No commas or periods are accepeted. For example one dollar should be informed as 100. Same as $1,2345.67 must be informed solely as 1234567
requests.name: Allows seller to update prices of a single SKU
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Allows seller to update prices of a single SKU

requests.description: Update product status in the Marketplace. Set to `true` to enable, `false` to disable sale.
requests.name: Enable/disable a single product in the Marketplace
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Enable/disable a single product in the Marketplace

requests.description: Update a single product inventory information. Products with zero stock will not be eligible for sale.
requests.name: Update a single product stock
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Update a single product stock

requests.description: Get a list of my products loaded into the Marketplace. This dosen't means that products are eligible for sale, just that they are loaded in the database.
requests.name: Returns a list of products loaded into BrandLovers Marketplace
requests.summary: Returns a list of products loaded into BrandLovers Marketplace

requests.description: This enpoint to creates new products in the Marketplace using `skuSellerId` as a primary key. This enpoint expects a json document with array of products. The server will load each product as an individual item that can be manipulated using your own `skuSellerId`. All requests to This endpoint are idenpontent with respect of the `skuSellerId`, this means that once a `skuSellerId` is created it cannot be re-created using this tool. In order to update use the PUT method with the correct `skuSellerId`. You can also use the POST /product to create a single product per request
requests.name: Allows new products from the seller to be loaded into the marketplace
requests.summary: Allows new products from the seller to be loaded into the marketplace

requests.description: Allows bulk update of product prices. This endpoint expects a json document with an array of products with the `skuSellerId` and the new price. Server will process each new product update individually and will ackwlodge as much updates as possible, even if a single product update fails. After this request you can query product final status with GET /product/status
requests.name: Allows bulk update of product prices.
requests.summary: Allows bulk update of product prices.

requests.description: Returns a list with seller products status. Please note that this endpoint will not return all details of each product, just the skuSellerId and status. Also please note that this endpoint will return 250 products per call. For full details of a given procuct use GET /product/{skuSellerId}
requests.name: Returns seller products status in the marketplace
requests.summary: Returns seller products status in the marketplace

requests.description: Bulk enable/disable products in the marketplace. This endpoint requires an array of objects with the seller SKU `skuSellerId` and boolean value that defines if the product is enabled or not for sale. This endpoint can be used to set a single product or many products.
requests.name: Bulk enable/disable products in the marketplace
requests.summary: Bulk enable/disable products in the marketplace

requests.description: Returns products that are successfully listed for sale.
requests.name: Returns products that are successfully listed for sale.
requests.summary: Returns products that are successfully listed for sale.

requests.description: Bulk product stock update. This endpoint expect a array of products `skuSellerId` with new inventory data
requests.name: Bulk product stock update
requests.summary: Bulk product stock update

requests.description: Use this service to create a new trouble ticket. Use this to include relevant information about the order, comunicate with the customer or marketplace team. Whenever possible message will be pushed to Mobile first. This is the primary mean of comunicaiton with the customer regarding orders, shippments, shippments status. New tickets will be automatically be set to 'OPEN'. Trouble tickets need to be associated with a orderId or customer. New tickets can optionally include a new message.
requests.name: Creates a new trouble ticket
requests.summary: Creates a new trouble ticket

requests.description: Add a new message to this trouble ticket. Messages can be `CUSTOMER` (customer will be able to see it) or `INTERNAL`.
requests.name: Add new message to trouble ticket
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Add new message to trouble ticket

requests.description: Returns trouble ticket history with all messages exchanged. Only tickets related to your seller will be returned. Attempt to read other tickets will return 403 (acess denied).
requests.name: Get trouble ticket messages
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Get trouble ticket messages

requests.description: Alows the seller to update the status of a trouble ticket
requests.name: Update trouble ticket status
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Update trouble ticket status
